global_summary: This video documents the design, construction, and real-world testing of a custom-built, futuristic three-wheeled electric concept vehicle. It progresses from initial studio presentation and concept renders, through detailed assembly of the chassis, motors, and complex electrical systems, to on-road demonstrations in urban environments. The narrative emphasizes the contrast between raw engineering and sleek minimalist design, showcasing both the vehicle's unique aesthetic and its functional electric drivetrain.
